summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined autofunction subsection after the Utilities entry in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run: tests, black, and flake8 were not executed, and line lengths were measured manually (all under 120). Deviation: the loader imports typing (Optional, List, Dict, Any) alongside os and json, because the spec's optional type hints need it. Nothing was committed.
